title: similarity/summary.json
description: Batch-level L3 descriptive aggregates: config x config x channel, the single data source for /matrix (DESIGN §5). Per variant (P-min / P-q each has its own matrix, DESIGN §5). Cells carry median / IQR / n_eff / both-m (BRIEF §4, DESIGN §5 tooltip). JUDGMENT CALL (flagged): scheme fixes the L3 STATISTICS byte-exactly (§5) but not the JSON shape of summary.json; the array-of-cells layout below is this contract's design. Diagonal cells = self pairs (self-consistency, a MEAN per §5, is reported in stats.json; the diagonal median here is the display value per DESIGN §5). Numeric fields are JSON numbers | null; see CONTRACT-NOTES for the rehash-determinism caveat. schema_version 1.0.0; file SHA256 + version frozen into lock (scheme §11).
$comment: schema_version: 1.0.0. The file-level schema_version lives here (structured $comment) so the lock-population loop (DATA-LAYOUT §4) reads one uniform source across all eleven schema files. All 17 channels (15 formal + 2 permanent diagnostics c-ncd / d-tagpath). Numeric cell fields are JSON numbers | null; the runner fixes one canonical float serialization for rehashed outputs (CONTRACT-NOTES §8).

batch_id.description: Owning batch id (date + event slug, DESIGN §2.2).

variant.description: Prompt variant this matrix set is computed over (scheme §9). Cross-variant analysis lives in /experiment/quality, not here.

channels.description: All 17 L2 channel names (scheme §4). Includes the 2 permanent DIAGNOSTIC channels (c-ncd, d-tagpath) which are DISPLAYED but never enter greedy pruning / statistics / hypothesis families (scheme §4 v9). The 15 formal channels are the remainder.

configs.description: Config ids in the manifest's PERSISTED array order (NFC UTF-8 byte order; scheme §1.2 — use sites never re-sort). Matrix row/column order is exactly this.

cells.description: One entry per (config_a, config_b, channel). Self cells: config_a == config_b (kind=self). Cross cells: kind=cross, A x B full cartesian, asymmetric-not-doubled (scheme §5). Whether both orderings (a,b)/(b,a) are materialized or only one is a runner choice — FLAGGED in CONTRACT-NOTES.

kind.description: self = self pair set C(m,2); cross = A x B cartesian (scheme §5).

median.description: Median of non-null S over the pair set. null when ineligible (n_eff<4, or cross with m_a<2 or m_b<2, or all-null) — matrix renders a gray 'insufficient data' cell (DESIGN §4.4). S in [0,1] by construction.

iqr.description: Inter-quartile range via linear interpolation, IQR=P75-P25 (appendix A). null when ineligible.

n_eff.description: Count of non-null S in this pair set (scheme §5). Summary eligibility needs n_eff>=4 (+ m_a>=2 & m_b>=2 for cross).
